مِرْوَلٌ , (IAar, T, K, in one copy of the T مُرَوِّلٌ,) like مِنْبَرٌ, (K,) A man having much slaver. (IAar, T, K.) ―
-b2- And [Bread, or food,] soft with seasoning. (IAar, T, TA.) ―
-b3- And A horse much affecting to act as a stallion. (IAar, T, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A piece of a weak rope: (AHn, M, K:) and a piece of a rope of which no use is made. (AHn, M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
